verses.en: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks.
verses.pt: Naquele dia, se cantará este cântico na terra de Judá: Temos uma cidade forte! Deus lhe pôs a salvação por muros e antemuros.
verses.en_web: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.
verses.en_bbe: In that day will this song be made in the land of Judah: We have a strong town; he will make salvation our walls and towers.

verses.en: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.
verses.pt: Abri as portas, para que por elas entre a nação justa, que guarda fidelidades.
verses.en_web: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.
verses.en_bbe: Let the doors be open, so that the upright nation which keeps faith may come in.

verses.en: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
verses.pt: Tu guardarás em completa paz aquele que tem firme entendimento, pois ele confia em ti.
verses.en_web: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
verses.en_bbe: The man whose heart is unmoved you will keep in peace, because his hope is in you.

verses.en: Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength:
verses.pt: Confiai no SENHOR para sempre, pois no SENHOR DEUS está a rocha eterna.
verses.en_web: Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.
verses.en_bbe: Let your hope be in the Lord for ever: for the Lord Jah is an unchanging Rock.

verses.en: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, even to the ground; he bringeth it even to the dust.
verses.pt: Pois ele abate aos que habitam em lugares altos, a cidade elevada; certamente ele a abaixará até o chão, e a derrubará até o pó.
verses.en_web: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.
verses.en_bbe: For he has made low those who are lifted up, all the people of the town of pride: he makes it low, crushing it down to the earth; he makes it low in the dust.

verses.en: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.
verses.pt: Pés a pisotearão; os pés dos afligidos, os passos dos pobres.
verses.en_web: The foot shall tread it down; Even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.”
verses.en_bbe: It will be crushed under the feet of the poor and the steps of those who are in need.

verses.en: The way of the just is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.
verses.pt: O caminho do justo é todo plano; tu que és reto nivelas o andar do justo.
verses.en_web: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.
verses.en_bbe: The way of the good man is straight; the road of the upright is made smooth by you.

verses.en: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O LORD, have we waited for thee; the desire of our soul is to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.
verses.pt: Também no caminho dos teus juízos esperamos em ti; em teu nome e em tua lembrança está o desejo de nossa alma.
verses.en_web: Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, have we waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.
verses.en_bbe: We have been waiting for you, O Lord; the desire of our soul is for the memory of your name.

verses.en: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
verses.pt: Com minha alma te desejei de noite, e com meu espírito dentro de mim te busquei de madrugada; pois quando teus juízos estão sobre a terra, os moradores do mundo aprendem a justiça.
verses.en_web: With my soul I have desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me will I seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: In the night the desire of my soul has been for you; early will my spirit be searching for you; for when your punishments come on the earth, the people of the world will get the knowledge of righteousness.

verses.en: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the LORD.
verses.pt: Ainda que se faça favor ao perverso, nem assim ele aprende a justiça; até na terra dos corretos ele pratica maldade, e não dá atenção à majestade do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see Yahweh’s majesty.
verses.en_bbe: Even if you are kind to the evil-doer, he will not go after righteousness; even in the land of the upright he will still go on in his wrongdoing, and will not see the glory of the Lord.

verses.en: LORD, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.
verses.pt: Ó SENHOR, tua mão está levantada, mas eles não a veem; porém eles verão e serão envergonhados pelo zelo que tens do teu povo; e o fogo consumirá a teus adversários.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people, and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.
verses.en_bbe: Lord, your hand is lifted up, but they do not see: let them see ... yes, your haters will be burned up in the fire.

verses.en: LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.
verses.pt: Ó SENHOR, tu nos fornecerá paz; pois todos os nossos feitos tu fizeste por nós.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
verses.en_bbe: Lord, you will give us peace: for all our works are the outcome of your purpose.

verses.en: O LORD our God, other lords besides thee have had dominion over us: but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
verses.pt: Ó SENHOR nosso Deus, outros senhores fora de ti nos dominaram; mas somente em ti, em teu nome, mantínhamos nossos pensamentos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but by you only will we make mention of your name.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord, our God, other lords than you have had rule over us; but in you only is our salvation, and no other name will we take on our lips.

verses.en: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
verses.pt: Eles estão mortos, não voltarão a viver; fantasmas não ressuscitarão; por isso tu os visitaste e os destruíste, e eliminaste toda a memória deles.
verses.en_web: The dead shall not live. The departed spirits shall not rise. Therefore you have visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.
verses.en_bbe: The dead will not come back to life: their spirits will not come back to earth; for this cause you have sent destruction on them, so that the memory of them is dead.

verses.en: Thou hast increased the nation, O LORD, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth.
verses.pt: Tu, SENHOR, engrandeceste esta nação; engrandeceste esta nação, e te fizeste glorioso; alargaste os limites da terra.
verses.en_web: You have increased the nation, O Yahweh. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.
verses.en_bbe: You have made the nation great, O Lord, you have made it great; glory is yours: you have made wide the limits of the land.

verses.en: LORD, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.
verses.pt: Ó SENHOR, na aflição eles te buscaram; quando tu os castigaste, uma oração eles sussurraram.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.
verses.en_bbe: Lord, in trouble our eyes have been turned to you, we sent up a prayer when your punishment was on us.

verses.en: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O LORD.
verses.pt: Tal como a grávida quando chega a hora do parto, sofre e dá gritos por suas dores, assim fomos nós diante de tua presença, SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Just as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs; so we have been before you, Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: As a woman with child, whose time is near, is troubled, crying out in her pain; so have we been before you, O Lord.

verses.en: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
verses.pt: Concebemos e tivemos dores, porém geramos nada além de vento. Não trouxemos libertação à terra, nem os moradores do mundo caíram.
verses.en_web: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
verses.en_bbe: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have given birth to wind; no salvation has come to the earth through us, and no children have come into the world.

verses.en: Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.
verses.pt: Os teus mortos viverão, junto com meu cadáver, assim ressuscitarão; festejai e sede alegres, vós que habitais no pó! Pois o teu orvalho é orvalho de luz, e a terra gerará de si seus mortos.
verses.en_web: Your dead shall live. My dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast out the departed spirits.
verses.en_bbe: Your dead will come back; their dead bodies will come to life again. Those in the dust, awaking from their sleep, will send out a song; for your dew is a dew of light, and the earth will give birth to the shades.

verses.en: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
verses.pt: Vai, ó povo meu; entra em teus quartos, e fecha tuas portas ao redor de ti; esconde-te por um momento, até que a ira tenha passado.
verses.en_web: Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.
verses.en_bbe: Come, my people, into your secret places, and let your doors be shut: keep yourself safe for a short time, till his wrath is over.

verses.en: For, behold, the LORD cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
verses.pt: Porque eis que o SENHOR sairá de seu lugar para punir a maldade dos moradores da terra sobre eles; e a terra mostrará seus sangues, e não mais cobrirá seus mortos.
verses.en_web: For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord is coming out of his place to send punishment on the people of the earth for their evil-doing: the earth will let the blood drained out on her be seen, and will keep her dead covered no longer.
